name: NYU Gallatin School of Individualized Study

residency.note: A minimum of 64 credits must be completed after matriculation in Gallatin; the last 32 credits must be completed at NYU (NYC or an NYU study away program).

creditCaps.label: Transfer credits (incl. AP/IB/Maturity Exam and pre-approved non-NYU courses); only grades of C or higher accepted
AP/IB/Maturity Certificate advanced standing credits (elective only)
Internship credits (admitted Summer 2015 and later); max 4 internship credits per semester

exceptions: Pass/Fail option may be used once per full-time academic year (once within 32 credits) and a maximum of four times during the academic career.
Courses graded with P do not count toward the Dean's List 12-credit graded minimum.

overloadRequirements.note: To exceed 18 credits: at least a 3.0 GPA, no Incomplete or NR grades, and adviser approval. 19-20 credits by adviser approval on the Plan of Study; more than 20 requires a Petition to the Office of Academic Advising.

deansListThreshold.note: Requires 12+ credits in graded (A-F) courses that count toward the GPA; courses graded N, NR, W, or P do not count toward the 12-credit minimum.
